units: <cite ref="Pesachim 70b:7">Pes. 70ᵇ</cite> <he>ואנן טעמא דפ׳ וכ׳</he> must we follow up the argument of seceders (that left the college and established a school of their own)?, v. <cite ref="Q02021"><he>פָּרַשׁ</he></cite>. [<cite ref="Tosefta Berakhot 3:25">Tosef. Ber. III, 25</cite> <he>כולל של מינים בשל פ׳</he> combines the prayer against the heretics with that against the renegades; Y. ib. II, 5ᵃ top <he>רשעים</he>.]

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 24:9">Lev. R. s. 24</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 19:2">Lev. XIX, 2</cite>) <he>כשם שאני פ׳ כך תהיו פרושים וכ׳</he> as I (the Lord) am pure, so be you pure; as I am holy, so be you holy.—Pl. as ab. Sifra K’dosh. beg. (expl. <he>קדשים</he>, Lev. l. c.) <he>פ׳ היו</he> be self-restraining.

Tosef. Sot. XV, 11; B. Bath. 60ᵇ כשחרב … רבו פ׳ וכ׳ after the destruction of the Temple the abstemious in Israel who refused to eat meat increased &c.—Esp. Parush, Pharisee, a strict observer of the Mosaic Law and the Rabbinical regulations.

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 1:15">Tosef. Sabb. I, 15</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 13a:2">Sabb. 13ᵃ</cite> <he>לא יאכל זב פ׳ עם זב עם הארץ</he> an observant gonorrhœist should not dine with an ignorant gonorrhœist (who is suspected of disregarding the laws concerning tithes, levitical cleanness &c., v. <cite ref="H00109"><he>חָבֵר</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 9:5:7">Y. Ber. IX, 14ᵇ</cite> bot. (speaking of the various kinds of Pharisees) <he>אין לך … פְּרוּשׁ אהבה כאברהם</he> of all of them none is beloved except the Pharisee from love (of God) like Abraham; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 5:5:4">Y. Sot. V, 20ᶜ</cite> bot.; Bab.

<cite ref="Sotah 22b:2">Sot. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>פ׳ מאהבה</he> a Pharisee from love (of reward, Rashi); <he>פ׳</he> (<cite ref="M00000"><he>מ</he></cite>)<cite ref="J00592"><he>יראה</he></cite> from fear (of punishment); <he>פ׳ שיכמי</he>, <he>ניקפי</he> &c., v. respective determinants.—Pl. as ab.

<cite ref="Sotah 22b:2">Ib.</cite> <he>אל תתיראי מן הפ׳ וכ׳</he> be not afraid of the Pharisees or of the non-Pharisees, but of the painted (the hypocrites) &c.—<he>מכת פ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="M01352"><he>מַכָּה</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Kiddushin 66a:9">Kidd. 66ᵃ</cite> <he>לבם של פ׳ עליך</he> the Pharisees are opposed to thee in their hearts; a. fr.—Fem. <cite ref="Q01740"><he>פְּרוּשָׁה</he></cite>.
